010ed948-541e-43c3-b2cc-bbea0e4a1aaf.narrative: Hello my name is is XXXX XXXX I opened up a bank account with navy federal credit union around mid XXXX, Then I applied for a credit card I was instantly approved & once I received the card I got a cash advance the same day, I was in XXXX trying to use my credit card it declined so I called & my phone died in the middle of the customer representative assisting me, Once I charged my phone back up I tried to login I see my bank account is locked so I called & they told me I had to wait 2-3 business days & call again so I did, So Im calling everyday at this point trying to figure why my account is locked. Week 2 I was told due to suspicious activity & I would have to submit an appeal form, so I submitted an appeal form I waited 14 business days my appeal was denied & your accounts will remain locked so I kept calling & 2-3 weeks ago I stepped into a branch & was told navy is terminating my membership infidelity for fraud but my whole thing is it wasnt fraud so Im confused & navy refuses to give me any more updates & I submitted another appeal it was denied I dont know what to do at this point its beyond unfair they had me submit all of this & step into a branch for them to simply close my account saying it was fraud?!?!?!!!!
